decisions.reason: Choosing a simple sales-funnel format for HubSpot reports does not change the deferred direct Sales Navigator-to-HubSpot synchronization requirement.
The reporting-format decision does not change how leads are transferred from HubSpot to MeetAlfred.
The simple sales-funnel report is independent of the MeetAlfred campaign creation and Zap setup workflow.
The HubSpot reporting-format decision does not affect the campaign domain name, registrar, or provisioning obligation.
